name: tools-stim2bin-layer
title: STIM2BIN - Layer 3 Stripe Image to Bin Converter
description:
This tool will convert layer 3 Stripe Images into .bin files that can be inserted as compressed ExGFX files and used with genericuploader.asm in order to save ROM space.

genericuploader.asm is included in the ExGFX Revolution Patch Set (in the Patches section).

Instructions are included in readme.txt
